Round 15 is a **FAIL** on one narrow point. Both target bugs are fixed and confirmed in a real browser, but one R15-P3 sub-check is not met. A had already listed that sub-check as not ready.

**Why it fails (C-R15-01, Low).** After closing the expanded video with Γ£ò or Esc, the library tree and list keep an empty `style=""` attribute. R15-P3 says there must be no `style` attribute at all. Nothing visible is wrong: padding and scroll height return to their pre-expand values, the texts are verbatim, and after ΓùÇ then Γû╢ there is no attribute. B needs to accept `style=""` or name another way to remove it.

**The two target bugs:**
- **C-R14-01 (rows under the video box) is fixed.**
  - In all four library cases (1440 and 1280 wide, library at 288 and 480) the box lands where B's formula puts it, within 0.02 px. It never covers the library controls.
  - At 1280├ù720 with the library at 480, finding "soft" and adding it by mouse now works. It adds one clip and one Undo entry, and the box doesn't move.
  - In every case, all 9 list rows and 9 tree rows can be scrolled clear of the box.
  - Walking the list with ArrowDown keeps each focused row above the box, and Enter on the last row adds one clip with one Undo entry.
- **C-R14-02 (Export dialog focus) is fixed.**
  - The exact round-14 repro now stays inside the dialog: X ΓåÆ WAV ΓåÆ ßâôßâÉßâ«ßâúßâáßâòßâÉ, then Enter closes it without rendering anything.
  - Eight Tabs and eight Shift+Tabs never leave the dialog.
  - Focus stayed inside the dialog in all 656 samples I took during a render.
  - The keyboard WAV export is valid: PCM, 2 channels, 48 kHz, 24-bit, 6.008 s, matching the project end. It is identical to round 14's file.

**Gates (all re-run by me), regressions and security.**
- vitest 965/965, tsc 0, Biome 0 errors, build passes.
- All hashes check out: frozen files, protected files and `Header.tsx` are unchanged, and A's backups match B's baseline.
- The working tree was the same at the start and end of my run.
- The adjacent quick regressions all pass: drag and resize, return paths, the temporary opening, library collapse and preview stop, and the dock.
- A new logged-out session opens the demo page with only the two demo MP3s and no token, recording, download or R2 requests. The token endpoint returns 401, a fake Bearer gets no token, and `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required". Premium auth is not bypassed.

**Two more Low bugs for B:**
- **C-R15-02:** adding a clip after the video is expanded selects it. That adds a 20 px line to the footer, so the library body gets shorter. The box doesn't re-place, so it ends up covering the top 12 px of the preview strip. No control is covered and every row is still reachable. B's placement and add-flow checks both pass as written; no check covers the body changing after placement. The same mechanism existed in round 14.
- **C-R15-03:** a weak test. I made the dialog's Tab handler also act on Enter, and all 116 tests still passed. The "only Tab is handled" test presses Enter only on the X, where that change does nothing. In the browser, Enter on the WAV button works today. My other five mutations each broke the intended tests.

I couldn't test real `prefers-reduced-motion`, because the browser tool doesn't allow that emulation; I only simulated it. That check stays with the Tech Lead, and the carried root items are listed in the report.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; start with `c-round-15.md`. The JSON verdict is `c-round-15.json`, and runs, gates, screenshots and the guard copy are under `c-round-15/`.
